prompts.piks: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite for No Heroes Below, a 2D cave tactics game. References: gameplay mockup establishes camera and pixel texture; roster establishes kobold anatomy, clothing and equipment. Match the high-contrast stylized painterly PIXEL ART of the small in-game units in the gameplay reference: visibly square pixel clusters, dark charcoal outlines, compact expressive silhouettes, warm amber upper-left highlights and cool navy shadows. Raised three-quarter top-down camera, approximately 35 degrees downward, near-orthographic with only slight isometric feel. Full body facing screen-right and slightly toward viewer, idle standing pose. Small readable game sprite, NOT a portrait or large smooth concept illustration. Transparent background with real alpha, no terrain, no pedestal, no UI, no text, no watermark, no colored selection ring, no cast ground shadow. Entire head, tools, feet and tail visible with generous empty transparent padding. One character only. Subject: Piks the Scout. A small wiry red-orange reptilian kobold with long snout, golden eyes, two small backward horns, pointed ears, curled tapering tail and bare clawed feet. Worn moss-green hood and short torn cloak, dark green scarf, brown leather belt with small pouches. Alert, clever expression. One hand casually holds a small wooden scouting whistle near his chest; the other relaxed. Use the green-hooded red kobold at the left of the roster as visual identity reference, but give Piks a whistle rather than the slinger's weapon.

prompts.pit_armed:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game hazard sprite, pit trap ARMED state, for No Heroes Below.

Raised orthographic camera about 35 degrees downward, slight isometric feel, no vanishing point. Fine stylized painterly pixel art, clearly square pixel clusters, charcoal outlines, upper-left amber highlights, cool slate shadows. Entire trap centered with generous transparent margin, no surrounding terrain slab, no scene or diorama, no people, no props outside footprint, no UI, no ring, no text, no labels or watermarks. Genuine transparent empty background, no glow and no cast ground shadow. This is the CLOSED ARMED state before the cover breaks.
